title: How to Cancel Substack — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Substack paid subscriptions. Manage individual newsletter payments and stop all recurring charges in one place.
intro: Substack is different from other services — you may have multiple paid newsletter subscriptions, each billed separately. You need to cancel each one individually through your payment settings.

steps.title: Go to Substack payment settings
steps.text: Visit substack.com/account/payments while signed in. This shows all your active paid subscriptions.

steps.title: Find the subscription you want to cancel
steps.text: Your paid subscriptions are listed with their monthly/annual price. Click on the one you want to cancel.
steps.tip: If you have multiple paid newsletters, you need to cancel each one separately.

steps.title: Click "Cancel" or "Manage"
steps.text: Click the cancel or manage option for that specific publication. Confirm when prompted.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Confirm your cancellation. You keep access to the paid content until your billing period ends, then revert to free posts only from that newsletter.
steps.tip: You'll still receive free posts from the newsletter in your inbox. Only paid-subscriber-only content becomes locked.

warnings: Each Substack newsletter is a separate subscription — cancel each one individually.
If subscribed through the Substack iOS app (Apple), cancel through iOS Settings → Subscriptions.
Canceling doesn't unsubscribe you from the newsletter — you'll still get free posts. Unsubscribe separately if you want to stop emails.
Your notes, comments, and bookmarks remain accessible.

faqs.q: How do I cancel all my Substack subscriptions at once?
faqs.a: There's no 'cancel all' button. Visit substack.com/account/payments and cancel each paid subscription individually.

faqs.q: Will I still get emails after canceling?
faqs.a: Yes — canceling a paid subscription only removes paid content access. You'll still receive free posts. To stop emails entirely, unsubscribe from the publication separately.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Substack?
faqs.a: Refunds are handled by individual newsletter publishers, not Substack. Contact the publication's author directly for refund requests.

faqs.q: What's the difference between cancel and unsubscribe?
faqs.a: Cancel = stop paying (but still get free posts). Unsubscribe = stop all emails from that newsletter. They're two separate actions.

refund.details: Refunds are at the discretion of individual newsletter authors, not Substack. Contact the publication author directly. Substack provides no centralized refund system.

retentionTactics: Individual authors may reach out personally when they see you've canceled.
Substack doesn't itself use retention tactics — each publication handles its own subscribers.
